title: CVE-2026-132147
summary: Affected: Debian debbugs An arbitrary file read vulnerability was discovered in debbugs, a bug tracking system based on the active Debian BTS. versions.cgi failed to correctly sanitize package name inputs in found and fixed query parameters. Crafted query parameters could cause version.cgi to output any lines of the target file which contained spaces.
